title: PocketDPE 式 FAA 飞行员口试语音陪练：AI 考官按 ACS 提问打分
title_en: PocketDPE-Style FAA Checkride Oral Coach: AI Voice Examiner Mapped to ACS
summary: 给备考 Private/Instrument/Commercial 的学员做语音模拟口试：AI 考官按 FAA ACS 提问、追问并给出 readiness 分数与复盘，学员为通过高 stakes 考试付周/月/年订阅。
summary_en: Voice mock orals for FAA Private, Instrument and Commercial checkrides: an AI examiner asks ACS-mapped questions, follows up, and scores readiness so candidates pay to rehearse out loud.
verdict: 收入经 RevenueCat 核验且近月增速快，客群窄但付费理由硬；复制者须守住自学工具边界并控制语音成本，稳态按小体量估算。

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $800 ~ $2,500 / 月（复制者稳态，单一证书口径；对标方 MRR $6,300 为成熟读数，不作承诺）

core_thesis.market_pain: 学员考前最怕口试被追问卡住：教材和闪卡只能默读，真人模拟口试要约教员时间且按小时收费，临考一周想天天开口练却约不到人。现有通用聊天机器人不懂 ACS 结构，问法散、评分无依据。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 把公开的 ACS 知识域做成结构化题库与评分量表，语音对话只做提问、追问和复盘，内容可人工校对、成本可控。切口是单一考试的口试环节，不做地面课全家桶，用免费试练加硬付费墙承接临考高意愿流量。

workflow_steps.title: 锁定一个证书的 ACS 题库
workflow_steps.detail: 只选 Private 先行，按 ACS 任务拆题，每题标注出处页码、标准答法要点与常见错误；找 5 名学员做真人模拟口试验证问法。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 单证书题库 v1 与评分量表

workflow_steps.title: 语音陪练 MVP
workflow_steps.detail: 实现听题、答题、追问、评分、复盘闭环；语音识别与合成走成熟 API，评分先用关键词加量表规则，AI 只做追问改写。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 可完整跑一轮模拟口试的 MVP

workflow_steps.title: 订阅与试用墙
workflow_steps.detail: 免费 1 次完整模拟，付费解锁无限练习与弱项报告；接入应用内订阅并在页面明示自学工具、非 FAA 批准培训、不替代教员。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 订阅付费墙与合规声明上线

workflow_steps.title: 学员社区冷启
workflow_steps.detail: 在飞行学员论坛与航校社群发免费模拟口试测评帖，收集真实追问补进题库；做 ACS 关键词落地页承接搜索。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 首批 20 名付费学员与题库迭代清单

pitfalls_to_avoid: 严禁宣称 FAA 批准或替代教员；AI 回答可能出错，必须提示以 ACS、FAR/AIM 与教员为准。语音成本按分钟计，须设单次时长与周上限。题库不得照抄受版权保护的商业题库原文。

en.title: PocketDPE-Style FAA Checkride Oral Coach: AI Voice Examiner Mapped to ACS
en.summary: Voice mock orals for FAA Private, Instrument and Commercial checkrides: an AI examiner asks ACS-mapped questions, follows up, and scores readiness so candidates pay to rehearse out loud.
en.verdict: Revenue is processor-verified with fast recent growth in a narrow, high-stakes niche; replicators must keep the self-study boundary and control voice costs.

deep_dive.opportunity: Candidates fear freezing under oral questioning. Books and flashcards are silent, human mock orals are scarce and hourly, and generic chatbots ignore ACS structure. A curated ACS question bank with a scoring rubric plus voice follow-ups turns scarce rehearsal into unlimited practice.
workflow: Phase 01: Build a single-certificate ACS question bank with sources, key points and common errors.
Phase 02: Ship a voice loop for question, answer, follow-up, score and debrief.
Phase 03: Add a free mock oral, paid unlimited practice, and clear self-study disclaimers.
Phase 04: Seed pilot communities and ACS search pages, then expand the bank from real follow-ups.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: Never claim FAA approval or instructor replacement. Warn that AI can err and official publications govern. Cap session minutes to control voice cost and write original questions.

title: Road to Offer 式咨询案例面试陪练：无限案例加 AI 复盘卖季票
title_en: Road to Offer-Style Consulting Case Interview Coach: Unlimited Cases With AI Debriefs
summary: 给冲刺咨询公司的候选人做案例面试练习：首个案例免费，付费解锁无限案例、 drills、语音练习与 AI 复盘，另卖单项测评包，靠招聘季高意愿收费。
summary_en: Case-interview practice for consulting candidates: a free first case, then paid unlimited cases, drills, voice practice and AI debriefs, plus one-time assessment packs sold into recruiting season.
verdict: 客单与付费理由成立且收入经 Stripe 核验，但招聘季季节性与案例内容生产是硬约束，只适合按季运营的复制者。

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $600 ~ $2,000 / 月（复制者稳态，招聘季口径；淡季更低）

core_thesis.market_pain: 候选人需要大量重复练习，但真人教练按小时收费、陪练伙伴水平参差，免费案例书只有题目没有评分。临近面试窗口时，缺的是随时能练、练完知道错在哪的反馈。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 把案例拆成结构、计算、沟通三个可评分维度，用原创案例加量表评分提供无限次练习，真人教练留给最后润色。免费首案做获客，90 天季票对齐招聘周期，测评包做单项加购。

workflow_steps.title: 原创案例与评分量表
workflow_steps.detail: 先写 20 个原创案例，每案配标准结构、关键计算与评分量表；请 5 名候选人盲测评分一致性。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 20 案题库与三维评分量表

workflow_steps.title: 练习与复盘闭环
workflow_steps.detail: 实现文字加语音答题、即时复盘与 drills；评分先走量表规则，AI 负责点评改写与追问。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 可完整练一案并出复盘的 MVP

workflow_steps.title: 季票与测评包
workflow_steps.detail: 首案免费，月付与 90 天季票解锁无限练习，单项测评模拟单独售卖；全站明示原创练习、与目标公司无隶属关系。

workflow_steps.title: 咨询社团冷启
workflow_steps.detail: 面向大学咨询社团与求职社区做免费案例夜与团购价，沉淀真实错题补 drills。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 首批 30 名付费候选人与错题库

pitfalls_to_avoid: 严禁使用目标公司的真实试题或宣称隶属/官方；商标只作 nominative 指向且须加免责。招聘季外需求陡降，须按季排内容与广告预算，不得按旺季收入做全年承诺。

en.title: Road to Offer-Style Consulting Case Interview Coach: Unlimited Cases With AI Debriefs
en.summary: Case-interview practice for consulting candidates: a free first case, then paid unlimited cases, drills, voice practice and AI debriefs, plus one-time assessment packs sold into recruiting season.
en.verdict: Pricing and willingness to pay hold with processor-verified revenue, but seasonality and case production cap the ceiling; best run as a seasonal product.

deep_dive.opportunity: Candidates need volume with feedback. Human coaches are hourly, peers are uneven, and case books do not score answers. Original cases with a three-part rubric give unlimited reps, while a free first case and a 90-day pass match the recruiting window.
workflow: Phase 01: Write 20 original cases with structures, math keys and a scoring rubric.
Phase 02: Ship text and voice practice with instant debriefs and drills.
Phase 03: Sell monthly and 90-day plans plus single-assessment packs with clear non-affiliation notices.
Phase 04: Seed consulting clubs and candidate communities, then grow drills from real errors.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: Never use real firm tests or imply affiliation. Demand falls outside recruiting season, so plan content and ads seasonally.

title: Play Designer Pro 式美式橄榄球战术板：画战术自动出球员测验
title_en: Play Designer Pro-Style Football Playbook: Draw Plays and Auto-Generate Player Quizzes
summary: 给美式橄榄球教练画进攻战术、管 playbook，并自动生成球员测验帮队员记住跑位，教练按月或按年付费，球队分享链接做传播。
summary_en: A play designer for American football coaches: draw offensive plays, manage playbooks, and auto-generate player quizzes so athletes learn assignments, sold as coach subscriptions with team sharing.
verdict: 需求具体、收入经 Stripe 核验、合规风险低；天花板受球队数量与赛季节奏限制，适合小而稳的垂直工具复制。

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $500 ~ $1,800 / 月（复制者稳态，单地区教练口径）

core_thesis.market_pain: 教练用纸和白板画战术，改一版要重画全队资料，球员记不住跑位只能靠训练场反复喊。通用画图工具不懂阵型与职责分工，画完也无法检验球员是否真懂。
core_thesis.opportunity_arbitrage: 把阵型、路线与职责做成结构化数据，画战术的同时自动生成球员测验，教练的交付物从一张图变成全队可检验的作业。球队分享链接让每个付费教练带来整队使用者，形成低成本传播。

workflow_steps.title: 阵型与职责数据模型
workflow_steps.detail: 只做进攻端，先支持常用阵型与路线，定义每个位置的职责字段；找 3 名教练用纸质流程对照验证。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 阵型模板与职责数据模型

workflow_steps.title: 画板加测验生成器
workflow_steps.detail: 实现拖拽画板、playbook 管理与一键测验生成；测验题由职责字段自动出题并判分。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 可画战术并生成测验的 MVP

workflow_steps.title: 教练订阅与球队分享
workflow_steps.detail: 14 天试用后按教练订阅收费，球队分享链接免费给球员做测验；导出打印做付费点。

workflow_steps.title: 教练社区冷启
workflow_steps.detail: 在教练论坛发免费战术模板包，赛季前做球队团购；收集真实战术补模板库。
workflow_steps.deliverable: 首批 20 支付费球队与模板库

pitfalls_to_avoid: 战术内容须原创或经授权，不得搬运付费 playbook。赛季外活跃度下降，须做休赛期留存设计。球员数据只收最小必要信息，未成年球员场景须遵守当地隐私要求。

en.title: Play Designer Pro-Style Football Playbook: Draw Plays and Auto-Generate Player Quizzes
en.summary: A play designer for American football coaches: draw offensive plays, manage playbooks, and auto-generate player quizzes so athletes learn assignments, sold as coach subscriptions with team sharing.
en.verdict: A specific need with processor-verified revenue and low compliance risk; the ceiling is bounded by team counts and season rhythm, fitting a small steady vertical tool.

metrics.est_monthly_profit: $500 - $1,800 / mo (replicator steady state, single-region coach scope)

deep_dive.opportunity: Coaches redraw paper plays for every change and cannot verify whether players learned assignments. Structured formations and responsibilities let one drawing become a testable team assignment, and share links turn each coach into a team-wide channel.
workflow: Phase 01: Model offensive formations, routes and per-position responsibilities with coach validation.
Phase 02: Ship a drag-and-drop board, playbook manager and quiz generator with auto-grading.
Phase 03: Sell coach subscriptions after a trial, with free team quiz links and paid print exports.
Phase 04: Seed coach communities with free templates and pre-season team offers.
deep_dive.risk_and_pitfalls: Use original or licensed play content only. Plan off-season retention and collect minimal player data, with extra care for minors.
